query: INSERT INTO route_draft_targets (id, routing_id, route_draft_id, provider_model_id, priority, weight, timeout_ms, position) SELECT t.id, t.routing_id, $1, t.provider_model_id, t.priority, t.weight, t.timeout_ms, t.position FROM UNNEST($2::uuid[], $3::uuid[], $4::uuid[], $5::int4[], $6::int4[], $7::int4[], $8::int4[]) AS t(id, routing_id, provider_model_id, priority, weight, timeout_ms, position)
